description: Find out whether a Canton Improvement Proposal (CIP) was actually acted on ON CHAIN, and how. Returns every DSO governance vote request whose text cites this CIP, with outcomes and dates. This answers 'was it decided', which the mailing-list tools cannot: get_cip_votes reads the discussion on the cip-vote list, this reads the ledger. Example: CIP-0116 (Featured App Locking) is cited in dozens of requests that paused apps for non-compliance. Canton ecosystem only, not Cardano or other CIP schemes.

limit.description: How many vote requests to return, newest first. Default 20, max 100. The response states the full count either way.

name: get_cip_vote_outcome
